products.proposed_body_html:
The full lunar cycle in eight phases, from new moon through waxing crescent to full and back. A clean, quiet chart made for a bedroom wall or a reading corner. The chart is original artwork drawn for this shop. It is not a photograph of the moon.

The size on sale is 18 by 24 inches, on matte fine art paper. A 12 by 16 inch size and a 24 by 36 inch size are not on this listing. It ships unframed in a rigid tube.

A vintage constellation chart of Ursa Major, reproduced from Sidney Hall's Urania's Mirror, published in London in 1825. The engraving shows the Great Bear and its neighboring stars exactly as a nineteenth-century astronomer would have drawn them, hand-colored and set against aged paper.

The size on sale is 18 by 24 inches, on matte fine art paper. A 12 by 16 inch size and a 24 by 36 inch size are not on this listing. It ships unframed in a rigid tube.

A vintage constellation chart of Orion, the Hunter, reproduced from Flamsteed’s Atlas Céleste, Plate 24 (1776). The engraving shows Orion and the neighboring stars of the winter sky, with fine linework and rich color set against aged paper.

The size on sale is 18 by 24 inches, on matte fine art paper. A 12 by 16 inch size and a 24 by 36 inch size are not on this listing. It ships unframed in a rigid tube.

products.note: The observed plate sentence was kept. This run did not check the zodiac-ring or four-season wording against the print file.
products.proposed_body_html:
An antique engraved chart of the solar system, after Andreas Cellarius's Harmonia Macrocosmica, published in Amsterdam in 1660. The Sun sits at the center inside a ring of the zodiac, with the orbits of the known planets and four seasonal views of Earth, all in hand-colored copperplate style.

The size on sale is 18 by 24 inches, on matte fine art paper. A 12 by 16 inch size and a 24 by 36 inch size are not on this listing. It ships unframed in a rigid tube.
